chapter: Back in New York: Heard and Dizzy
title: Bus travel and being stranded in Brussels on the European tour
summary: The band travelled by bus and went to Europe, where a European agent absconded with the money and stranded them in a Brussels hotel.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: So did you tour by bus at this time or by train or...?
All the members of the band on the same bus?

Yeah, uh huh, sure. We did all right and we went to Europe, the first jazz band from America after the war. That was a tremendous... we got up into...where were we at?...the European agent run off with the money and we were stuck in the Metropole Hotel in (Belgium)...this European agent run off with the money and we were stuck in the hotel; we were stranded. So Billy Shaw, who was Milt's father, he had to fly over and I don't know what all happened but anyway we got out of there...hahahaha. But Brussels is more expensive than New York, you know what I mean, because they have the Belgian Congo and, gee, you go to those stores and everything was expensive. We was afraid to go out of the hotel. And that was quite an experience.
